description: EPS actual vs analyst (consensus) estimate, beat or miss, for a company's recent quarters, the "earnings surprise" history. Returns per quarter: fiscal period, EPS actual, EPS estimate, surprise amount and percent. Revenue is NOT included (Finnhub's earnings-surprise data is EPS-only); for revenue estimates on upcoming quarters, see get_earnings_calendar. The free Finnhub plan returns at most the latest 4 quarters; a response with fewer quarters than asked says so in history_note and points to av_earnings for 12. Example: get_earnings_surprises({ symbol: "MSFT", limit: 4 })

_apiKey.description: Finnhub API key (get one free at finnhub.io)

limit.description: Number of most-recent quarters to return (default 4, max 20)

name: get_earnings_surprises
